title: Long Chen
text:
LONG CHEN
Incoming Ph.D. studentIndustrial EngineeringNortheastern UniversityBoston, MA, USAchen.l19 AT northeastern DOT edu


 CV
 GitHub
 LinkedIn @ lchen1307







I am a M.Phil. student in Operations Research, advised by
Prof. Lindong Liu
at the School of Management,
University of Science and Technology of China (USTC),
and a member of the IDEA Lab.
I expect to graduate with a master's degree in the summer of 2026.
Prior to that, I obtained my B.S. in Industrial Engineering from
Jiangnan University in 2023.

My research lies at the intersection of integer programming,
machine learning, and statistics.
I am particularly interested in developing algorithms that are
not only efficient but also reliable and fair, with the goal of
supporting the design of cutting-edge decision-making tools.
My work is often inspired by complex, real-world challenges in
high-stakes domains such as emergency management and
two-sided platforms.

🎉 I am thrilled to be joining Northeastern University in Boston to pursue my PhD in Industrial Engineering under the supervision of Prof. Tugce Martagan!
